retrieval: web search/open of primary publications or their abstracts and official software documentation; original paraphrases, not archived full texts
scope: Targeted novelty screen, not systematic review or proof of absence

sources.title: Enhanced secondary analysis of survival data
sources.locator: Results: standard errors of log hazard ratios; accuracy and reproducibility methods
sources.finding: Reconstruction accuracy and reproducibility, including log-HR standard errors, were evaluated. Missing auxiliary information can underestimate uncertainty.
sources.distinction: Rules out claiming that reconstruction variability or auxiliary-information dependence is newly discovered.

sources.title: Improved curve fits to summary survival data
sources.finding: Fits survival models using estimated patient data from summary survival information for economic evaluation.
sources.distinction: Original reconstruction and downstream model fitting are established.

sources.title: Reconstructing time-to-event data from published Kaplan-Meier curves
sources.finding: The ipdfc command implements reconstruction from curves, with auxiliary information including total events.
sources.distinction: Implementing another Guyot-style reconstruction is insufficient.

sources.title: IPDfromKM: reconstruct individual patient data from published Kaplan-Meier survival curves
sources.locator: Discussion on variability of test statistics; Tables 3 and 4; accuracy assessment
sources.finding: Compares logrank conclusions in five POLAR curve pairs and six simulated pairs; also compares bootstrap HR intervals. Reports agreement. Uses curve-fit diagnostics.
sources.distinction: Directly defeats generic novelty based on comparing reconstructed and original significance decisions. Does not provide a complete feasible-set certificate in the inspected methods.

sources.title: A review and comparison of methods for recreating individual patient data ... a simulation study
sources.finding: Compares reconstruction methods across sample sizes, censoring and parametric models, including uncertainty in mean survival.
sources.distinction: Generic reconstruction-accuracy and uncertainty simulations are established.
sources.access: PubMed primary abstract and publisher indexed text

sources.title: A Method for Reconstructing Individual Patient Data From Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves That Incorporate Marked Censoring Times
sources.locator: Abstract and indexed primary article text
sources.finding: Uses marked censor times, curve drops and sample size to reconstruct IPD without requiring a risk table or uniform censoring.
sources.distinction: Censor marks must be a matched information comparator; blanket impossibility without risk tables is too strong.
sources.access: primary abstract read; PMC open returned challenge

sources.title: A non-linear optimisation method to extract summary statistics from Kaplan-Meier survival plots using the published P value
sources.finding: Uses a reported P value as an additional reconstruction constraint to infer summary statistics.
sources.distinction: When the same decision's P value is published, reconstructing that decision is unnecessary. A future benchmark must retain it as information when available.
sources.access: full text and primary PDF text read

sources.title: Using Quadratic Programming to Reconstruct Data From Published Survival and Competing Risks Analyses
sources.finding: Constrained QP/MIQP incorporates auxiliary information and benchmarks against IPDfromKM and censor-mark reconstruction. Two-arm benchmarks include Cox/Weibull HR, RMST difference and proportionality test statistic.
sources.distinction: Constraint-rich optimization and downstream test-statistic accuracy are already covered. Proposed gap is bounding a specified decision over all compatible reconstructions and selecting information to resolve it.

sources.title: RESOLVE-IPD: High-Fidelity Individual Patient Data Reconstruction and Uncertainty-Aware Subgroup Meta-Analysis
sources.finding: Generates plausible subgroup-label assignments consistent with summary statistics and propagates their uncertainty in meta-analysis.
sources.distinction: Ensembles and uncertainty propagation are not new. Proposed pilot concerns censor-order ambiguity within fixed arm labels and an exhaustive decision bound.

sources.title: KoMbine: Propagating Statistical and Systematic Errors to Kaplan-Meier Curves
sources.finding: Models patient inclusion or biomarker-assignment uncertainty with likelihood penalties and computes survival comparisons.
sources.distinction: The proposed censor-order reconstruction set is a different uncertainty source; no claim to invent uncertainty-aware survival tests.

sources.title: Reconstructing Individual Patient Level Survival Data from Aggregate Survival Data using a Simulation Approach
sources.status: primary conference abstract; full journal methods not established here
sources.finding: Simulates multiple survival/censoring datasets to estimate alternative summaries and reconstruction uncertainty under nonproportional hazards, comparing with Guyot.
sources.distinction: A multiple-reconstruction uncertainty workflow alone overlaps this prior work. Complete compatibility bounds and information-query utility remain the narrowed target.

sources.title: Validating Restricted Mean Survival Time Estimates From Reconstructed Kaplan-Meier Data Against Original Trial Individual Patient Data From Trials Conducted by the Canadian Cancer Trials Group
sources.finding: Blinded RMST validation against original IPD across 39 trials reports small reconstruction discrepancies.
sources.distinction: Real-IPD RMST validation is established. Those patient files were not acquired in this round.

sources.title: Reconstructing patient level survival data from published Kaplan-Meier curves
sources.finding: Evaluates reconstructed hazard ratios and confidence intervals against reported values, including 58 reconstructed HRs.
sources.distinction: A routine audit of reproduced HRs/CIs would add little without a distinct decision or validation target.

sources.title: KM-PoPiGo benchmark documentation
sources.status: primary developer documentation for a preprint-associated method
sources.finding: Documents Real IPD, Published KM and Synthetic KM benchmarks at Zenodo record 18320575. The application supports sample-size, event-count, risk-table and censoring constraints.
sources.distinction: Do not create a generic benchmark without checking/reusing this one. Download was not achieved: Zenodo returned HTTP 429. Contents and licenses require file-level verification.
sources.access: developer docs and source repository read; preprint DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8789849/v1 could not be opened

sources.title: SciPy logrank documentation
sources.finding: Defines the ordinary two-sided logrank score and right-censored inputs used by the independent numerical check.
sources.distinction: Verification uses installed SciPy 1.18.1, not a second hand-coded score formula.
